text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One effective method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and track their progress. It is also important to define milestones and deliverables so everyone knows what needs to be completed and when. Additionally, aligning all stakeholders early in the process ensures that everyone shares the same expectations and supports the project. When these elements are combined, projects are more likely to be completed on time and to a high standard.
